## Findings
- claim-1: For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) with \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), Theorem 4.8 gives two integral generating families for \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 847-892]
- claim-2: The paper explicitly says: “the techniques utilized in [GR02] seem very particular to the case where \(X_w\) is defined by inclusions. We do not know how to use them for some alternate approach to the case of general \(X_w\) considered in this paper.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 928-937]
- claim-3: In the inspected window, `[GR02]` occurs both in the inclusion-case discussion and in the open-method remark. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 893-901]
- claim-4: Conjecture 4.10 asserts minimality of both Theorem 4.8 families and reports computer verification for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-946]
- claim-5: The stronger statement \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\) is presented as a suspicion, followed by “So far a proof has eluded us.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 956-975]
- claim-6: No supplied source identifies `source-30`, supplies its prior extraction, or specifies an all-document keyword set; hence completeness of that extraction cannot be verified from the available record.
## Strategy
Use the recorded targeted search result: RWY, *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety*, DOI `10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3`, full-text SHA-256 `34367d…`. It supplies the omitted open-method remark at lines 934–937 and local `[GR02]` occurrences at lines 901 and 934. The supplied full-text index also records `[GR02]` at lines 69, 91, 200, 727, 901, 934, 1147, and 1232. This is a bounded literal audit of that retrieved text, not an audit of immutable `source-30`.

The current objects match the source’s \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), its integral coefficient ring, and its two Theorem 4.8 families [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 847–892]. The source explicitly states the omitted semantic remark [lines 934–937].

## Gaps
The requested target is **not established**. No durable mapping identifies the retrieved full-text candidate with `source-30`; the prior “source-30 extraction” is absent; and no finite keyword list or literal/semantic matching convention is supplied. Therefore completeness, exact omissions, and repeated-reference coverage for `source-30` cannot be verified.

## Next
Required missing evidence: a durable `source-30`-to-artifact mapping, the extraction under audit, and a declared keyword/matching specification. Only then can a deterministic complete hit audit be performed.
